pretreatments.description: Thermal hydrolysis treatment performed in a 10 L agitated autoclave (Class IV), consisting of temperature increments at 110 °C, 165 °C, and 220 °C in electric mode or 165 °C in steam mode, with 30 minute treatment duration. Solubilisation of COD and VS was utilized to evaluate the degree of disintegration of pretreated sludge. Laboratory thermal hydrolysis (electric mode) was compared with industrial-scale steam mode injection for pretreatment.
